paragraph: R05 matched TabM recipe: embedding+statistics (1040 inputs) versus full relation (2064) scores 1668/2114 versus 1606/2114 hard questions: +62 (+2.93 pp; saved paired 95% interval [1.51, 4.40] pp), with fold 0/1/2 gains +45/+11/+6; all-question gain +62. This is not a pure feature-information effect: input width changes first-layer capacity and random initialization even at the same fixed seed. The interval is conditional on selected OOF predictions and retains search optimism.
